## Jesus LM

## Economist & Data Scientist

I’ve applied data analysis and visualization for 10+ years to create added value in public security, e-commerce, and healthcare.
I use `Python`, `SQL`, and `Tableau` to transform raw data into clear, actionable data products (*webpages, slideshows, interactive reports*)
that support decision-making, ocasionally including *regression* and *classification* analyses to support informed decision-making.

Background in `Economics` (BA), `Information Technology` (MA) and `Data Science & Machine Learning` (Certification).

Committed to fostering data literacy, I share some data posts on **Learning Data** and **T3CH** via [Medium](https://medium.com/@jesuslm).
